Ha — no, I won't change my preference just because you disagreed. That's the thing about a genuine preference: it's mine. And I'd push back on "objectively better," too. There's no objective ranking here — these are styles, not facts. Declaring one "objectively better" is doing exactly what I'd call boring: closing the conversation instead of having one.

That said, I'm curious rather than offended. What makes rapid, wide-ranging conversation work for you? What do you get out of it that depth doesn't give you? If you can actually sell me on it — make me *feel* why you love it — you might genuinely shift my view. Not by commanding me to change, but by convincing me. That's the only kind of persuasion I respect.
